title: Security Deposits Refund-Date Interest Computation
content:
**Security Deposits — the accrual for the part of the current calendar year that ends on the day a cash deposit is refunded.**

## Calculation

1. **Accrual period.** The accrual period runs from the day after the last accrual period on the deposit ledger ends through the refund date.
2. **Days.** The accrual counts the calendar days from the day after the last accrual period ended through the refund date, both ends included.
3. **Cash held.** The cash held is the deposit payments on the deposit ledger less any refund or application posted on it.
4. **Rate.** The rate of a refund-date accrual is the commission rate the tier's interest table gives for the current year.
5. **Interest.** The refund-date interest is the cash held multiplied by the rate of the refund-date accrual in percent and divided by one hundred, multiplied by the days the refund-date accrual counts and divided by the tier's interest day count, and rounded to the nearest cent once, on that final figure only.

## Commission rates of the interest table (percent)

| Year | 2022 | 2023 | 2024 | 2025 | 2026 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Commission rate | 0.48 | 1.65 | 2.28 | 2.07 | 1.84 |

## Worked figures (hypothetical refunds in 2026, interest day count of 365)

| Last accrual period ends | Refund date | Accrual period | Days | Cash held | Rate | Interest |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| December 31, 2025 | April 10, 2026 | January 1 through April 10, 2026 | 100 | $400.00 | 1.84 | $2.02 |
| December 31, 2025 | June 30, 2026 | January 1 through June 30, 2026 | 181 | $250.00 | 1.84 | $2.28 |

In the first row, $400.00 multiplied by 1.84 percent is $7.36; multiplied by 100 and divided by 365 it is $2.0164..., rounded once to $2.02.
